context.p: A nested segment is one where you can insert a segment inside an existing segment. To insert nested segment:

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
From the Contracts pane, click the Home button () and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab, click the Dropdown button ()and select Segments. Open the segment that you need to add a nested segment to.

Highlight a block of text inside the segment and click Conditional. This opens the Segment Condition dialog box that contains the expression builder. For more information on how to create condition, see Making Segment Conditional. Now you have created a nested segment.
